name: cavemio-api-keys
title: API keys
description: The API keys screen, done properly: the secret rises in once, and Done folds it down into the "sk_live_••••4f2a" it leaves behind.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The secret only ever lives in the component's state while it is on screen; it leaves the page once Done has folded it away. Store a hash on your server, never the key.
- The new key's Copy button takes focus as the secret opens; Done hands focus back to "Create key". Creating, rolling, revoking and hiding the secret are announced in a status region outside the list.
- Roll and Revoke ask first: the icon becomes a cross and the confirm button opens beside it. Escape, the cross, or a click or focus elsewhere takes the question back.
- The expiry countdown is hidden from screen readers (it would re-announce every second); they hear the time the key expires instead.
- Rows glide with additive transforms measured from layout offsets, and a revoked row folds away as its own detached element, so nothing re-renders for it.
- Reduced motion opens, seals and removes in place; the chip and the secret simply swap.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: value
props.description: – · Controlled keys: { id, name, prefix?, last4, scopes?, createdAt?, lastUsedAt?, expiresAt? }. Never the secret.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: – · The list after every create, roll and revoke, newest first.

props.name: onCreate
props.description: – · Creates a key. Return it with the whole secret, which is shown once; throw to keep the form and show the error's message.

props.name: onRoll
props.description: – · Issues a new secret. Return previous (the old key with expiresAt) to keep it listed while it still works. Without onRoll there is no roll button.

props.name: onRevoke
props.description: – · Revokes a key; the row leaves once it resolves. Throw to show Try again. Without it there is no bin.

props.name: scopes
props.description: – · What a key may do; the form shows them as toggles and asks for at least one.

props.name: defaultScopes
props.description: – · Scopes a new key starts with. All of them by default.

props.name: title
props.description: "API keys" · Heading and the list's accessible name.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: "e.g. Production server" · The name field's placeholder.

useCases.title: Developer dashboards
useCases.description: The Settings → API keys page of any product that has an API.

useCases.title: Scoped keys
useCases.description: Let people choose what a key may do before it is created.

useCases.title: Personal access tokens
useCases.description: A page where each person creates and revokes their own tokens.

useCases.title: Internal platforms
useCases.description: Keys per service or environment, such as “Production server”.

features.title: The secret is shown once
features.description: It appears under the name with a Copy button. Done folds it away and the secret leaves the page.

features.title: What is left is a masked key
features.description: The prefix and last four characters fly into the key’s chip, so it reads like sk_live_••••4f2a.

features.title: Scopes when you create
features.description: The form shows what a key may do as toggles and asks for at least one.

features.title: Rolling without a gap
features.description: The new secret opens in the same row, and the old key can stay listed, counting down to its expiry.

features.title: Revoking asks first
features.description: The bin stretches into “Revoke”, a check draws, then the row folds away. A failure says Try again.

features.title: Errors keep your input
features.description: If creating fails, the form keeps the name and scopes and shows the server’s message.

states.title: create
states.description: "Create key" opens a form row at the top of the list; it fades in from a blur while the rows below glide down 480ms. Escape or Cancel folds it away. A missing name or scope shakes the field and says why under it.

states.title: creating
states.description: Create key turns into "Creating" with a spinner while onCreate runs. If it throws, the form keeps the name and scopes, the button says Try again and the error lifts in under the form.

states.title: reveal
states.description: The form fades out over the key it became while the row eases to its new height in 460ms. The secret rises in under the name, each character out of a 4px blur, the whole of it inside half a second. Copy takes focus; it turns into Copied with a drawn check.

states.title: seal
states.description: Done closes the fold in 460ms. The secret's prefix and last four characters fly into the chip together, as words (540ms), the dots rise in between them and the chip's thin line fades in behind; everything else blurs out. The secret then leaves the page.

states.title: roll
states.description: The roll icon stretches into "Roll key". Once onRoll resolves, the chip lifts away through a blur and the new secret opens in the same row. If onRoll returns the old key with expiresAt, it fades in underneath as "Expires in 23:59:41", its numbers rolling down a second at a time.

states.title: revoke
states.description: The bin's circle stretches into a red "Revoke"; it spins, a check draws and the row dims for 700ms, then folds away while the rows below glide up. A failure shakes the button and says Try again.

states.title: last used
states.description: "Last used 2 min ago" rolls its number and morphs its unit as time passes, re-rendering only when the words change.
